name: Emissary-Class Infiltrator Robot
languages: Common plus up to three other languages

items.name: Puzzleblade
items.description:
Upgrades: 1

This kasathan sword breaks down into interlocking pieces for storage and transport. Traditionalists practice the art of ritually assembling puzzleblades, with different pieces symbolizing the kasathan virtues of conviction, dedication, moderation, and tradition. Criminals and smugglers value the puzzleblade for its discreet design.

items.name: Semi-Auto Pistol
items.description:
Upgrades: 1

This pistol automatically ejects used cartridges and loads new ammunition after every shot fired.

items.name: Hacking Toolkit (Advanced)
items.description: A hacking toolkit is required for Computers checks to Hack computers. You can use a hacking toolkit to access a computer without using a user interface, but this requires physical contact with the computer or contact via an infosphere or a similar linked network. An advanced hacking toolkit adds a +1 item bonus to checks made with it and allows you to access computers at a range of 30 feet, unless you're in a radioactive environment.

items.name: Infiltrator's Toolkit (Tactical)
items.description: You need an infiltrator's toolkit to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Pick a Lock]{Pick Locks} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Disable a Device]{Disable Devices} (of some types) using the Thievery skill. A tactical infiltrator's toolkit adds a +1 item bonus to checks to Pick Locks or Disable Devices.

offensiveAbilities.name: Adaptive Disguise
offensiveAbilities.description: An emissary-class infiltrator robot is covered in a layer of synthetic programmable skin that counts as a disguise kit. The robot can alter the skin over the course of a minute to Impersonate a Medium humanoid ancestry or specific person (if it has information about that person or has previously interacted with them). If the robot makes a retractable spike Strike or uses Morphing Visage, it takes a –4 circumstance penalty to its Deception DCs and skill checks to Impersonate against any who witnessed the action

offensiveAbilities.name: Exploit Nausea
offensiveAbilities.description: An emissary-class infiltrator robot's Strikes deal an additional 3d6 precision damage to sickened creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Morphing Visage
offensiveAbilities.description:
By sending ripples through its synthetic skin, the emissary-class infiltration robot creates a nauseating display that affects all creatures within 20 feet that can see it. Each creature in the area must attempt a DC 30 Will Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes immune to the robot's Morphing Visage for 10 minutes.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Sickened 1.

Critical Failure The creature is Sickened 2.
